versions.changelog:
- Migrated all files from the previous skills/ directory root to a new baoyu-slide-deck/ directory structure.
- Added and reorganized reference files under baoyu-slide-deck/, including multiple style, layout, and dimension references.
- Updated metadata and documentation to reflect new directory layout.
- No changes to core code functionality—this update mainly restructures and relocates reference and documentation files.

**This version introduces a major update, integrating advanced slide design features and multi-stage PPT workflow.**

- Added baoyu-slide-deck module with detailed visual style references and configuration guides.
- Significantly expanded internal documentation and modular references for structured PPT design, including layout, style, mood, typography, and various preset options.
- Removed older standalone Python script and outdated usage documentation to reflect the new pipeline approach.
- Prepared the foundation for three-stage PPT workflow (structure, content, visual optimization) with enhanced customization and professional slide output.

Initial release of course-ppt-generator skill.

- Enables automatic generation of university-level course PPTs for a variety of subjects, including data science, Python, deep learning, and more.
- Supports multiple teaching scenarios: lecture slides, lab guides, review materials, and academic presentations.
- Produces structured, visually appealing PPTs with standardized sections and blue professional theme.
- Provides flexible input options: course topic, field, type, audience, slide count, and style preferences.
- Ensures every PPT includes AI-generated content identification.
- Actively retrieves up-to-date examples and data to enrich teaching content when user input is limited.
